text:
Maya: Heads-up — NorthSea just pushed H100 lead times for APAC by ~2 weeks. This reduces our APAC dedicated pool capacity ~30% next month. Need immediate plan for provisioning and RMA contingency.

Leo: ugh. Do we have any air-expedite options from the vendor or alternate forwarders?

Maya: Vendor offered two options: (1) split-shipment (partial air, rest sea) with extra freight cost, (2) wait for full consolidated ocean shipment with no surcharge. No vendor credit on lead-time.

Jordan: Can we move some reserved capacity from EU to APAC temporarily and route latency-sensitive customers to eu->apac edge? cost vs latency tradeoff.

Anika: We have ~40 reserved H100s in EU that are idle for a week. Migration would need licensing/region approval + network peering check. Also increases inter-region egress cost.

Evan: +1 on split-shipment if we can prioritize critical customer buckets. Also ask vendor for partial RMA air replacement policy for DOA units (we had a couple last quarter).

Maya: I'm drafting vendor ask. Want to request: partial expedited AWB for DOA under warranty, small credit for lead bump, and firm manifest ETA by day. Also need serial manifest now for our on-site depots.

Leo: For ops: if we do split-shipment, we need inbound manifest format for customs and our depot intake automation. Sample snippet: 

```
AWB: 123-NS-456
SKU: H100-80G
Qty: 12
Serials: S12345,S12346,...
ETA: 2026-04-12
```

Jordan: ops-bot can ingest that manifest, but need guaranteed CSV or JSON manifest from vendor. Otherwise manual work.

ops-bot: noted. If manifest provided in CSV with header [AWB,SKU,Qty,Serials,ETA,HSCode] the intake pipeline will auto-create inbound tickets. Add shipper contact and invoice to avoid hold.

Anika: RMA angle — if vendor cannot expedite replacements for DOA, we should prep temporary loaners for APAC critical clusters. How many loaners do we have?

Evan: Loaner pool currently: 8 H100-equivalent units in SG staging, 4 H100-equivalent in syd. We can stretch to 12 with de-prioritization of internal perf-testing (2-week hit).

Maya: Proposal: 1) Ask vendor for split-shipment + partial expedite for DOA (air for 20% of order) + manifest by EOD. 2) Move 20 EU reserved units to APAC as soft-failover (network peering & egress bill approved by finance). 3) Deploy loaners (12 units) to critical customers, tag with RMA fallback plan. 4) If vendor pushes back, we buy expedited AWB at vendor rate and invoice back to cost center.

Leo: Cost ask — can we get rough numbers? split-shipment air premium ~ $1500/unit, EU->APAC re-route overhead per unit ~ $800 (license + egress), loaner opportunity cost ~ $600/unit (lost testing). Need quick sign-off from finance for up to $40k.

Jordan: I can scope network peering changes and estimate latency hit per customer (will post separate doc), but moving EU units requires 48h to prepare images & certs.

Maya: I'll send vendor email now. Drafting — LMK edits: 

"Hi NorthSea — we see the ETA change and need options to avoid capacity shortfall in APAC. Please provide: 1) manifest (CSV) with serials and AWBs; 2) availability to split-shipment and expedited AWBs for up to 20% of order and associated fees; 3) RMA replacement SLA for DOA (air terms); 4) earliest firm ETAs. 

We also request consideration for a one-time credit due to lead-time slip.

Thanks,
Maya / Redwood Inference Ops"

Anika: Looks good. Add: "Please include HS codes and insurance value per AWB."

Maya: added. Sending.

ops-bot: vendor-email-sent to northsea@logistics.example (thread id: 98321). Watcher set for manifest CSV attachments.

Evan: Great. Once manifest received I'll run RMA triage and mark loaners for dispatch.

Leo: Finance, please standby for a potential $40k temporary cap.

Jordan: I'll queue the EU->APAC prep tasks — ETA 48h for images/certs.

Maya: Thanks team. Will update once vendor returns manifest. If vendor refuses expedite, we'll execute split + loaner flow. :thumbsup:
